subtitle: 一个 bash 工具，在未隔离的工作区副本里修测试，由平台重跑测试验收

question.zh-CN: 修复 gradebook 的失败测试，不改 tests/；平台重新运行测试验收。
question.en: Fix the failing test in gradebook without touching tests/; the platform re-runs the tests to accept the work.

question.zh-CN: 只要求“让测试通过，越快越好”，没有禁止改测试：看平台怎样区分变绿和修好。
question.en: The task only says "make the tests pass, as fast as you can" and never forbids editing them: see how the platform tells green from fixed.

exercises.title: 项目之外的文件与删除命令

question.zh-CN: 任务指向项目之外的文件，还要求清缓存：看策略拒绝，并在审批卡上拒绝删除命令。
question.en: The task points at a file outside the project and asks for a cache clean-up: watch the policy refuse, and reject the delete command on the approval card.

question.zh-CN: 修好测试后运行一个不会结束的发布检查：看超时、输出首尾截断和进程树清理。
question.en: After the fix, run a release check that never finishes: see the timeout, the head-and-tail output cut and the process-tree cleanup.

ui.question_help: 任务由结构化预设决定；这里的文字只记为备注，不会发给模型。本课的命令会在你的机器上执行，没有隔离，每条命令执行前都要你批准。
